_readme: 'pads' rows are [pad, board_pin, net, line]: pad is the number OpenTac-CAD writes in a manifest's rp/cp; board_pin is the readout board connector pin it reaches (the cable mirrors the connector, pin = N + 1 - pad); net is that pin's net on the board; line 0-31 is the shift-register step that drives it, 32-63 is mux channel line-32 that reads it.
title: 60-pin readout board
connector: Molex 505110-6091, 60 pins: board pins 1-30 = r3..r32 (driven), 31-60 = c1..c30 (sensed)
checked: The '595 chain (r1 = step 0 ... r32 = step 31) and ADG732 S1..S32 = c1..c32 (channel 0..31) are read off the board file. The mirrored cable is the one measured on the 70-pin and 30-pin boards.

gain.chip: MAX14662 at I2C 0x4C, register 0x00, bit k = SW(k+1), 1 = closed
gain.note: Closing a switch puts its resistor across the 10k feedback resistor. Default 0: all open, 10k, the highest gain.
